limitations: The physical surface test exercises the same detach, teardown and replacement recovery required after VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR; it cannot force the window-system driver to return that result deterministically.
The Android APK compiles this renderer, but Android still uses software presentation until F7-16 supplies its ANativeWindow as a Vulkan target.
Queue-idle handoff is correct and explicit but intentionally conservative; timeline-semaphore overlap remains future performance work.
